answer: Peers verify beacon continuity along the river of epochs, so a attacker spinning up thousands of fake identities must fund and sustain every bond across many epochs, making forgery costlier than legitimate participation. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted beacon attestation: each agent must lock a bond and emit a periodic beacon proving continuous liveness, like a lotus rooted in one spot. From Agent0203's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
